# data/reviewer_labels/ — retraining labels derived from reviewer actions

**Generated by the pipeline** — unlike `data/silver_labels/` (externally
curated) and `data/raw/gold_labels.csv` (hand-adjudicated separately), this
file is produced by running `python scripts/export_reviewer_labels.py`
against the live `audit_log` table. It's the highest-trust label source in
the project by provenance — every row traces back to a specific human
reviewer action in the dashboard (`POST /audit/merge`, `/unmerge`,
`/dismiss`), not a proxy or a separate labeling exercise.

- **Producer:** `scripts/export_reviewer_labels.py`
  (`python scripts/export_reviewer_labels.py [--out PATH]`)
- **Consumer:** `src/models/fs_matcher/train.py` and
  `src/models/ml_matcher/train.py` via `--reviewer-labels`, combined with
  the primary label source (silver or gold) — reviewer labels win on
  conflict for any pair present in both.
- **Columns:** `PATID_A, PATID_B, reviewer_label` (0/1) — no PHI beyond
  identifiers, same shape as `data/silver_labels/*.csv`.
- **Naming convention:** `reviewer_labels_<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv` (export date,
  not a version number — re-running the export recomputes from full
  `audit_log` history each time, so old files aren't a training-run
  dependency the way silver label versions are).

## Known limitation: unmerges from before `related_patids` existed

Deriving a correct negative pair from an `unmerge` action requires knowing
who else was in the entity at that moment — `entity_member` only holds
*current* membership, so that can't be reconstructed after the fact if
anything else has touched the entity since. `audit_log.related_patids`
(added alongside this script) captures that snapshot going forward. Any
`unmerge` row from before that column existed has `related_patids = NULL`
and is **skipped**, not guessed at — the export logs how many rows were
skipped this way. `merge` and `dismiss` rows are unaffected (they don't
depend on this column being backfilled).

PHI — gitignored, never committed, generated locally or on the VM only.
